# Good Syntax Examples
# This file demonstrates proper bracket matching and syntax structure

namespace = syntax_good

# Example 1: Simple event with proper brackets
syntax_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_good.0001.t
	desc = syntax_good.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_good.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 2: Nested blocks with proper closing
syntax_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_good.0002.t
	desc = syntax_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		age >= 16
		OR = {
			is_ruler = yes
			AND = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_adult = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_good.0002.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
		else = {
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}
}

# Example 3: Decision with proper bracket structure
syntax_good_decision = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = syntax_good_decision_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	effect = {
		remove_short_term_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 200
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Example 4: Scripted effect with proper nesting
syntax_good_effect = {
	every_vassal = {
		limit = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = {
				has_trait = lazy
			}
		}
		add_opinion = {
			target = root
			modifier = grateful_opinion
			opinion = 10
		}
	}
}

# Example 5: Complex nested structure
syntax_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_good.0003.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_trait = brave
				}
				desc = syntax_good.0003.desc_brave
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_trait = craven
				}
				desc = syntax_good.0003.desc_craven
			}
			desc = syntax_good.0003.desc_default
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_good.0003.a
		trigger = {
			has_trait = brave
		}
		add_prestige = 100
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_good.0003.b
		add_gold = 50
	}
}
